description: This file defines the `LogFileIterator` class within the `Aws\CloudTrail` namespace. It provides an iterator to efficiently list and filter AWS CloudTrail log files stored in Amazon S3, supporting features such as date range filtering, trail name handling, and prefix-based filtering. The class interacts with AWS SDK clients (`S3Client` and `CloudTrailClient`) to retrieve and process log file metadata from S3 buckets.

classes.name: LogFileIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for listing and filtering CloudTrail log files stored in S3, supporting date range and prefix-based filtering, designed for use in AWS SDK PHP applications.

methods.name: forTrail
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a LogFileIterator for a specific trail by retrieving the associated S3 bucket information via the CloudTrail client.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the iterator with specific S3 client, bucket name, and filtering options such as date range, trail name, account ID, and region.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current log file's bucket and key as an array, integrating with PHP's Iterator interface.

methods.name: buildListObjectsIterator
methods.description: Builds and returns an iterator over S3 objects filtered by prefix, date, and regex-based criteria based on provided options.

methods.name: normalizeDateValue
methods.description: Converts different date input formats (string, DateTime, integer) into a Unix timestamp for filtering purposes.

methods.name: determineDateForPrefix
methods.description: Generates a date string pattern for the S3 key prefix based on start and end dates, supporting wildcard matching.

methods.name: applyRegexFilter
methods.description: Applies a regex-based filter to limit S3 objects to those matching specific key patterns, considering wildcards.

methods.name: applyDateFilter
methods.description: Filters S3 objects to those whose embedded timestamps fall within the specified start and end date range.
